title: Key a check's worktree root through the same worktree-key cache as the writers
outcome: Round-19 review (Claude, tm-winf steps 2+3). Overlap marking compares engram_path_key(check.target.root), resolved uncached through engram_worktree_root_path when the check starts, with writer keys taken from the process-wide 30 s engram_worktree_root cache (workdir_worktree, running_command_worktrees, note_engram_host_write). If a nested .git appears or disappears inside a worktree within the TTL (git init, git worktree add or a clone in a subdirectory), the two keys can disagree, a concurrent writer is not marked, and the check could be reported Succeeded despite the overlap: the one direction the design otherwise never errs in. Rare. Fix direction: derive the check's overlap key from the same cache, or drop cache entries under a path when a check starts; add a test with a nested .git created mid-check.
